root.name: Italian Game: Scotch Gambit
root.moves: 1. e4 e5 2. Nf3 Nc6 3. Bc4 Nf6 4. d4 exd4 5. O-O

overview: White castles and leaves the d4 pawn en prise for open lines and quick development. 5...Bc5 6.e5 d5 is the Max Lange Attack with long, forcing tactics; 5...Nxe4 6.Re1 d5 is the main alternative, where Black keeps the extra pawn and White gets pressure on the e-file. Both sides take risks and one inaccurate move can lose quickly.

white_ideas.idea: Max Lange Attack: 6.e5 d5 7.exf6 dxc4 8.Re1+ Be6 9.Ng5 with attack on the king.
Re1 and Bxf7+ ideas, using development lead to attack the king.

black_ideas.idea: Take the pawn with ...Nxe4 or ...Bc5 and defend accurately, returning the pawn at the right time.

typical_structures.structure: Open centre, White with fewer pawns, Black king facing e-file pressure.

character.notes: Forcing, concrete, mutual attacking chances (Max Lange).

gambit.notes: Black can keep the d-pawn or e4-pawn.

soundness.notes: Sound; objectively balanced, playable at all levels.

approach.notes: Standard, played by strong players as a surprise weapon.

level.notes: Max Lange needs long forcing lines.

sublines_that_differ.name: Double Gambit Accepted
sublines_that_differ.how: Black keeps a pawn, White presses on the e-file.

character.reason: Forcing tactical lines with mutual attacks.

gambit.reason: White gives a pawn that Black can keep.

structure.reason: The centre opens at once and play is on open lines.

approach.reason: Played by strong players now and then.

level.reason: Max Lange requires long forcing lines.

plans.reason: White's compensation is development and attack on f7 and the king.
